maint.noWorkOrders: No work orders in this period
maint.reconciliationHint: MTBF and MTTR are measured two ways over the same window. The Downtime Command Center shows the equipment lens; this report headlines the maintenance lens.
maint.formulaMaintMttr: Maintenance MTTR = Σ repair hours ÷ corrective + emergency work orders completed in the window. Repair hours use the logged actual hours, falling back to started → completed elapsed time.
maint.formulaMaintMtbf: Maintenance MTBF = operating hours ÷ corrective + emergency work orders raised in the window. Operating hours are the summed RUNNING machine-state hours, falling back to active machines × window hours when no state history exists.
maint.formulaEquipMttr: Equipment MTTR = Σ breakdown stop hours ÷ breakdown stop count — the production time lost, not technician wrench time.
maint.formulaEquipMtbf: Equipment MTBF = (capacity hours − all downtime hours) ÷ breakdown stop count, where capacity hours = window hours × active machines in scope.
maint.inclusion: Included as failures: unplanned breakdown stops and mechanical, electrical or utility stops; corrective and emergency work orders.
maint.exclusion: Excluded: planned maintenance, cleaning, breaks and changeovers; micro-stops, starved, blocked and external stops; material, operator, quality and process stops; preventive, inspection and lubrication work orders; cancelled and deleted work orders.
maint.windowNote: Both lenses use the report window selected above. Open stops are clamped to now, and stops crossing the window edges are clamped to the window. The Maintenance module KPI cards use a month-to-date window by design, so they match this report only when the same period is selected.

qual.noData: No inspection data in this period
qual.fpyFormula: First Pass Yield = passed quantity ÷ inspected quantity × 100 — units accepted at first inspection, before any rework.
qual.defectFormula: Defect Rate = failed quantity ÷ inspected quantity × 100 (equals 100 − FPY). Defect PPM is the same ratio expressed per million units.
qual.sourceNote: Source: inspection results recorded inside the selected period. Identical definitions to the Quality module KPI cards, so both screens always agree. NCR counts are shown for context and do not feed FPY.

advKpi.selectLine: Select a production line in the scope panel.
advKpi.bottleneckAuto: No bottleneck configured — using the slowest routing cycle time. Set it in Plant Hierarchy → Edit Production Line.
advKpi.lineOeeWhy: A line runs at the speed of its constraint. Averaging every machine misrepresents it, because assets downstream of the bottleneck idle by design whenever it stops.
advKpi.missingCapacity: {{count}} machine(s) have no routing cycle time, so they add nothing to the denominator.
advKpi.rollupWhy: Quantity-weighted across every machine on the line — the minutes and counts are summed, then A, P and Q are re-derived from the totals. It is not an average of machine percentages.
advKpi.changeBasis: Change the basis in Plant Hierarchy → Edit Production Line.
